Approach to Secure Access Control and GDPR Compliance # CHIYU is dedicated to developing products that prioritize both access control and personal security. This foundational goal shapes every aspect of our product development, ensuring that our solutions are not only reliable but also align with evolving privacy and security standards, such as the European Union’s General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
Encrypted Communication with OSDP # A crucial aspect of secure access control is the encryption of communication between readers and controllers. CHIYU integrates the Open Supervised Device Protocol (OSDP), which provides:
Encrypted communication channels Consistent and high-security standards Enhanced interoperability among devices from different manufacturers Bi-directional communication and read/write capabilities This ensures that sensitive data remains protected throughout the access control process.
Biometric Data Security # When it comes to biometric recognition, such as facial and fingerprint identification, CHIYU takes extra precautions. Our approach includes:
Encrypting all biometric templates Ensuring that biometric data is never stored as image files Selecting biometric modules that meet stringent security requirements This commitment helps safeguard personal data and supports compliance with privacy regulations.
Software Encryption Standards # For software solutions, CHIYU employs AES-128 encryption within our SOMAC software suite. This level of encryption is designed to provide robust protection for all sensitive information processed and stored by our systems.
If you have further questions or require more information about our secure access control solutions and GDPR compliance, please feel free to contact us.

Proximity Controllers and RFID Door Access: Technology and Solutions # A proximity controller is a universal touchless technology designed to detect nearby objects using electromagnetic fields or beams of electromagnetic radiation, all without physical contact. This technology is widely implemented in RFID door entry systems, which have become an integral part of modern security and access control solutions.
How Proximity Controllers Work # RFID door entry systems operate by detecting if a user is within a certain range. When a user presents their RFID card, the system recognizes the card, and the display typically turns off, resulting in lower power consumption. This efficient operation makes proximity controllers suitable for a variety of environments where secure, contactless access is required.
Product Offerings # As a manufacturer specializing in RFID door access control systems, Chiyu Technology provides a range of solutions, including support for 26/34 bits and other bit ranges to accommodate different security requirements. For more information or to discuss your needs, please contact Chiyu.

智慧安防新紀元：門禁與影像監控一體化解決方案 # 台北，台灣 — 全球數位監控解決方案領導廠商晶睿通訊（台灣證交所股票代碼：3454）近年來積極以多角化策略結盟，強化自身安防解決方案。此次，晶睿通訊攜手成立滿20週年、深耕門禁系統領域的七友科技，結合雙方通路實力與高品質技術，推出全新整合的智慧門禁安防影像系統。
一站式整合，提升管理效率 # 傳統上，影像監控與門禁系統的整合往往需仰賴第三方，導致建置初期投入大量人力與成本，專案負擔沉重。透過晶睿通訊與七友科技的合作，智慧門禁安防影像解決方案可快速導入各種場域，顯著提升出入口安全性。七友門禁系統能即時連動晶睿通訊安防攝影機的人臉辨識功能，讓進出人員管理更準確有效。出入口影像記錄書籤功能則方便管理人員快速追蹤與應對突發狀況。
友善介面，簡化安裝與管理 # 全新系統可透過晶睿通訊影像管理軟體 VAST 2 統一管理，使用者可在友善介面中輕鬆設定設備，並同步管理影像與門禁系統，大幅簡化以往繁瑣的安裝流程與操作體驗。晶睿通訊完整的網路攝影機產品線，讓用戶能依據不同場域光線與環境條件，彈性部署多元化攝影機，滿足各種應用需求。
市場應用與合作展望 # 七友科技總經理張秉仁表示：「影像與門禁結合的智慧安防系統已是市場趨勢。透過與安防領導品牌晶睿通訊的結盟，整合雙方專長技術與通路，能在全球安防市場展現強大競爭力。」目前，該系統已成功應用於台灣國防單位及商業大樓等多元場域。
晶睿通訊品牌事業群執行副總經理顧中威指出：「很榮幸能與七友科技合作，藉由其深厚通路經驗與產品實力，進一步強化晶睿通訊的附加價值。未來，我們將針對不同應用場景與垂直市場，持續推出更多高整合性的智慧安防解決方案。」
